description: The bar chart compares the performance of various models across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (Sentiment Acc.), STS Correlation (STS Corr.), and Paraphrase Accuracy (Paraphrase Acc.), with the y-axis representing Accuracy/Correlation on a scale from 0 to 0.8. The models evaluated are Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, listed along the x-axis. For each model, three bars are displayed, colored light yellow for Sentiment Acc., light pink for STS Corr., and light blue for Paraphrase Acc., as indicated by the legend. The 2-Tier SimCSE model consistently achieves the highest scores across all three metrics, with its STS Corr. bar reaching approximately 0.81, its Paraphrase Acc. bar at about 0.79, and its Sentiment Acc. bar around 0.49. The Supervised_SimCSE model follows with a high STS Corr. of about 0.80 and a Paraphrase Acc. of approximately 0.78, while the Unsupervised_SimCSE model shows a lower STS Corr. of about 0.71. The baseline models, Single-task_baseline and Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, exhibit lower performance, particularly in STS Corr., with values around 0.50 and 0.58 respectively. The chart clearly demonstrates that the 2-Tier SimCSE model outperforms all other models in this comparison.
